answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 21172 Country: India Title: is this right to perform four marrieges in islam at a same time? Question: is this right to perform four marrieges in islam at a same time? Answer ID: 21172 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 637/429/L=1431) One can perform four marriages at a time. قال تعالى: فَانكِحُواْ مَا طَابَ لَكُم مِّنَ النِّسَاء مَثْنَى وَثُلاَثَ وَرُبَاعَ الآية . [النساء : 3] If one is not able to carry out the rights of all and fears for injustice one must not perform more than one nikah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
